title: ExpenseReceipt
description: Standardized schema for extracting expense receipts and tax invoices.

receipt_info.description: General document metadata and receipt details.

receipt_number.description: The receipt or tax invoice document number (เลขที่ใบเสร็จ/ใบกำกับภาษี).

transaction_date.description: The date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2026-08-15).

transaction_time.description: The time of the transaction in HH:MM:SS format (e.g., 14:30:00).

expense_category.description: The classification of the expense, such as Food & Beverage, Transport, Office Supplies, Delivery, Utilities, etc.

payment_method.description: Method of payment, e.g., Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer, ShopeePay, TrueMoney, GrabPay, QR Pay.

name.description: The official name of the merchant or store.

tax_id.description: The merchant's 13-digit Tax ID (เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษี) in Thailand, if available.

branch.description: The merchant's branch name or branch number (e.g., สำนักงานใหญ่ or 00001).

address.description: The full address of the merchant.

phone.description: Contact phone number of the merchant.

customer.description: Buyer or customer details (if specified on tax invoice/receipt).

branch.description: Customer branch name or branch number.

items.description: Detailed list of items or services purchased.

name.description: The description or name of the item.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., PCS, KG, BOX, LOT, Hours).

unit_price.description: Price per unit of the item.

total_price.description: Total price for the item (qty * unit_price).

totals.description: Financial summary and total amounts of the transaction.

currency.description: Currency code of the transaction (e.g., THB, USD, EUR).

subtotal.description: Total amount before discounts and taxes.
